mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.address, s.business_hours as businessHours, s.phone, s.description, s.average_cost as averageCost, s.rating, s.price_min as priceMin, s.price_max as priceMax, s.created_at as createdAt, s.updated_at as updatedAt, s.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName FROM shop s LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.address, s.business_hours as businessHours, s.phone, s.description, s.average_cost as averageCost, s.rating, s.price_min as priceMin, s.price_max as priceMax, s.created_at as createdAt, s.updated_at as updatedAt, s.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName FROM shop s LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
